label: Razorpay
description: Automate customers, orders, payments, invoices, items, plans, subscriptions and payment links

operations.name: list_customers
operations.description: Fetch one page of customers belonging to the connected merchant.

operations.name: create_customer
operations.description: Create a customer record. This does not charge the customer.

operations.name: list_orders
operations.description: Fetch one page of merchant orders, without expanded payments.

operations.name: create_order
operations.description: Create an order for checkout; this does not itself capture a payment.

operations.name: list_payments
operations.description: Fetch the provider's default page of payments, not the whole history.

operations.name: list_refunds
operations.description: Fetch one page of refunds without initiating a refund.

operations.name: list_invoices
operations.description: Fetch the default page of invoices; no invoice is issued or emailed.

operations.name: create_item
operations.description: Create a reusable invoice item with an amount and description.

operations.name: list_items
operations.description: Fetch the provider's default page of invoice items.

operations.name: create_plan
operations.description: Create a recurring billing plan; no subscription or charge is created.

operations.name: list_plans
operations.description: Fetch the provider's default page of subscription plans.

operations.name: create_subscription
operations.description: Create a subscription requiring customer authorization before charging.

operations.name: list_subscriptions
operations.description: Fetch the provider's default page of subscriptions.

operations.name: create_payment_link
operations.description: Create a standard payment link with explicit notification choices.

operations.name: list_payment_links
operations.description: Fetch the default page of standard payment links; no notifications are sent.
